body: REVIEW FINDING (2026-10-26): this provider's adapter ALREADY EXISTS in OpenChamber's quota module (server/lib/quota/providers). Re-scope from "build adapter" to: wire the existing provider into the quota gatherer (#1151), verify it against the live account on the gatherer host (credential provenance is the open question, per #1155), fix gaps found, and confirm its output shape maps onto quota-current. Keep this issue open until the provider is arriving on the 15-minute tick.

## Intake review

- **Related:** epic #1047 (quota plane, Stage 2, order 5b); design `quota-plane-design-2026-10-26.md` (usage-billing-hub goal files, §2); #1113 (per-credential workspaces), #1118 (lapse dates); sibling adapters #1159 (5a), #1163 (5c), #1165.
- **Still live:** a merged-PR search found no resolving PR; the issue carried only `meta/follow-up` before this pass.
- **Notes:** the body states "Priority P1" in prose — normalized here to `priority/high`. Its Acceptance line has been expanded into the appended `## Acceptance criteria` section (original body preserved verbatim above it).
- **Risks:** time-sensitive — the Personal workspace lapses Nov 2 and Lab Nov 6, so the lapsed-state handling is not an edge case, it is the near-term steady state; per-workspace credentials (#1113) must not be conflated or one workspace's lapse will read as the other's error.
- **Suggested approach:** build the two-workspace read with lapse as a first-class state from day one; verify against the console for both workspaces before the first lapse date.
- **Labels normalized by fleet monitor:** `kind/feature`, `priority/high` (P1 in body), `effort/m`, `source/human`, `status/needs-triage`, `meta/enriched`.
